note: Source publishes CIE 1931 2-deg chromaticity x,y and luminance Y (percent) under illuminant C. CIELAB computed from that published xyY using the C white point (Xn=0.9807, Yn=1.0000, Zn=0.9005); method 'derived_from_xyy'. Value-10 white chips whose published Y slightly exceeds the white point (L*>100) had L* clamped to 100.0 (n=21). Hex is a clamped sRGB display approximation (full Munsell range exceeds sRGB).
